claims.value: Dayhoff is a hybrid state-space-model transformer architecture with mixture-of-experts for protein language modeling. It natively handles long contexts and supports order-agnostic infilling. The 170M UR90 variant is trained on metagenomic data.
claims.evidence: The Dayhoff architecture is a hybrid of state-space Mamba layers and Transformer self-attention, interleaved with Mixture-of-Experts modules... natively handles long contexts... order-agnostic infilling
